notes: Latest CRAN release. Old API: estimate()/defineNetwork()/defineNodes()/subModel/estimationInit. No data object; objects pulled from calling env.
First tidyverse-style API: make_*()/estimate_dynam()/estimate_rem()/make_data(). No engine iteration guaranteed.
Diagnostic methods + autograph plotting; mode imputation for non-numeric attributes; fix for preprocessed-data formula comparison; max_iterations=0 supported. New API.

Rate preprocessing refactor: rate statistics stored as n1xnEffects matrix instead of n1xn1xnEffects 3D array (drops reduceMatrixToVector). Unified preprocessing output fields; new effects degree()/triangle()/global(); reserved db/db_table options. New API.
Commit immediately BEFORE refactor-preprocess-estimate began (parent of task 0.1 baseline commit). Pre-refactor baseline; new API with monolith preprocessing and post-hoc C++ gather_().
Phase A milestone bump: compute_stats() export + typed model_spec + rate_ordered sub_model + REM sub_model deprecations.
Recipes milestone bump: flat stat_mat_update buffer + recipe dispatch + preprocessed.goldfish format version. Since reachable on origin/develop; the earlier local-only note no longer applies.
Estimation milestone bump: spec-class estimation dispatch + combined C++ flat buffer. Since reachable on origin/develop; the earlier local-only note no longer applies.
Writers milestone bump: writer strategy + native R gather (C++ gather_() removed) + DBI streaming writer. Since reachable on origin/develop; the earlier local-only note no longer applies.

refactor/rate_prep HEAD: release consolidation. New API + compute_stats(output=gather|db) + rate_ordered sub_model + engines default_c/gather_compute/default. Since reachable on origin/develop; the earlier local-only note no longer applies.
